title: Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald - Battle! Steven
description:
My other Super Famicompo submission!
This is the theme that plays during the Champion battle in Pokémon RSE (yes, in Emerald the Champion is Wallace, but the song is the same :shrug:), fitting for bosses.
It took me a while to upload because I wanted to fiddle with it a bit, but in the end I decided against it.
